verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe an in-product AI you can ask about any device, threat, or compliance gap. It surfaces answers, automates remediations and builds audit-ready reports (docs-24), and 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data' is listed as a plan capability (docs-32). It can also act on device telemetry before a ticket is filed, which implies proactive suggestions (docs-25). missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the AI insights and suggestions work, explicit evidence of proactive suggestions rather than only Q&A answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
